theorems.name: Submission.cbrr_ud_lusin_of_aestronglyMeasurable
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) {Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace Y] [TopologicalSpace.PseudoMetrizableSpace Y] [SecondCountableTopology Y] (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (A : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → Y) (p : Euclid P → Prop), MeasurableSet A → μ A ≠ ∞ → AEStronglyMeasurable f (μ.restrict A) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict A), p x) → ∀ η : ℝ≥0∞, η ≠ 0 → ∃ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ A ∧ μ (A \ K) < η ∧ (∀ x ∈ K, p x) ∧ ContinuousOn f K
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
